'''Yolten''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] who served aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]]. He worked as a flagship commissioner during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yolten first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', an expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]], as a flagship commissioner.<ref name="TOR" />
